intro: St. Kevin's GFC is powered by the generosity of local businesses. Every euro of sponsorship goes directly into teams, facilities and our juvenile section.
becomeText: From pitch-side signage to jersey sponsorship and match-day partnerships, there's a package to suit every business. Talk to us about getting your name in front of the North Kildare community every week of the year.
